topic: Committer CHECKPOINT write-urge — structurally validated fields must be semantically consumed
insight: The RETURN field passed structural validation but was semantically orphaned, causing the Committer to write output files after commits. Fix: protocol-level consumption of the field + Exit medium specification ('in the response text') + positive-framing completion step. Every dispatch field must be either consumed by protocol, explicitly documented as metadata, or removed from the dispatch template.
